chapter: Highlights, the reunion album and fellow musicians
title: Ben Webster, Chu Berry and Tricky Sam Nanton
summary: He praises Webster and Nanton's plunger and recalls Chu Berry's death.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Trumpeters I admired: rating the horn players

blocks.x: Ben Webster was a beautiful tenor player for me, too. I didn't know, I didn't know Chu Berry (inaudible) so long because he and Roy were with Teddy Hill (inaudible). And then he went with Cab, and not too long after that, I think that's when he had that unfortunate accident somewhere on the road.
Tricky Sam. I don't know his name.
Right. You know them all, too.
Tricky Sam was with Duke Ellington when he had that plunger. When he used to do that, that was amazing cause I had heard him,
I hadn't heard that before. So, I got up and I liked that.
